refs: Refs #1368 (interactive follow-up; the guard bug itself was addressed by #1430)
title: test-craft interactive collect/finalize handshake
goal: Make test-craft runnable in an interactive session (Claude Code, where the calling agent is the LLM judge) by giving it the same two-step collect -> finalize handshake code-craft / api-craft / naming-craft / cli-ergonomics-craft already have. Before this, test-craft only had the inline runTestCraft, which loudly refuses the in-session provider, and had no test_craft_finalize tool.

pipelineStages.summary: Export CRITIQUE_SYSTEM_PROMPT; export pure buildPrompt({test,rubric,sourcePair?}) and parseFindingFromRaw(raw,{test,rubric}); inline critiqueOne now composes both (mirrors code-craft/critique.ts).

Enumerate the same (test, rubric) pairs runTestCraft uses (reusing extractTestsFromFiles + source-pairing), build one prompt per pair, persist run-state to the shared craft runs store under a new runId, return { runId, pendingPrompts, projection, status } with a prompt-count budget guard. No LLM called.

Load run-state by runId (clear error when missing or skill-mismatched), parse each responses[].raw fenced JSON into a TestFinding via the shared parser, delete run-state, return the same TestCraftOutput shape runTestCraft returns.
test_craft becomes the collect handler (in-session default returns prompts + 'call test_craft_finalize'; inline otherwise). New test_craft_finalize handler + definition.

registrationSites: packages/cli/src/mcp/server.ts (import block, TOOL_DEFINITIONS array, TOOL_HANDLERS map)

localChecks.test: pass (50 tests: test-craft/critique + test-craft/integration + mcp/tools/test-craft + mcp/server + mcp/server-integration)

assumptions: The established collect pattern across the four sibling craft skills builds prompts directly via the exported buildPrompt; it does not drive the InSession provider deferred queue. test-craft mirrors that.
finalizeTestCraft needs only { test, rubric } to rebuild a finding (source-pair is used only at collect-time prompt build), so run-state persists the ExtractedTest + rubricId per prompt.
critiqueErrors is always 0 in the finalize summary: the calling agent answers every prompt, so there is no per-critique LLM throw to count.
emitTo is inline-mode only; in-session collect/finalize does not write the machine-readable report.
Owning package for the changeset is @harness-engineering/cli; minor bump (new MCP tool + new interactive capability).
Refs #1368 (not Closes): #1368 is the guard bug, already addressed by #1430; this is the interactive follow-up.
